text:
Type: standing jewelry armoire
Use: storing jewelry and accessories; bedroom, dressing area
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: black lacquered wood, carved columns, metal knobs
Colors: glossy black, silver
Shape: tall narrow cabinet, many shallow drawers with round knobs, bowed front, turned side columns, molded top and plinth base, upright
Feel: elegant, formal, dramatic
Goes with: dark wood, white or deep walls, silver accents; traditional or classic bedrooms

product.name: Alveare Home Louisa Locking Jewelry Armoire, Black
product.description: 8 spacious drawers feature divided compartments and open storage Locking top lid keeps precious pieces safe 2 side doors open to reveal 10, double tiered jewelry hooks Top compartment equipped with a vanity mirror, ring rolls, additional storage compartments and a cord management hole to keep cables out of sight as devices charge Beautiful vintage black finish with antiqued brass hardware Dimensions: 39.8" H x 17.5" W x 11.6" D
